summary: Buenaventura Mining filed a Form 6-K (US equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report) disclosing board approval, at the October 29, 2026 board meeting, of an interim cash dividend charged to 2014 retained earnings totaling $151,819,518, equal to $0.5508 per share across 274,889,924 common shares (BUENAVC1) and 744,640 investment shares (BUENAVI1). Record date is November 20, 2026 with delivery December 2, 2026; Bank of New York Mellon set the ADR payment date at December 9, 2026, one ADR equaling one common share. Routine capital return, no deal terms; watch ADR payment timing and subsequent distribution policy.
